scope: Read-only byte comparison and bounded parsing of PS3 EU original STR files and processed canonical Full/alternate FullFlattened resources. No game runtime observed.

methods.path_mapping: normalized_map.json original_path denotes already-reorganized Full, not original disc; compare full bytes after map lookup.
methods.archive_parser: Parent module reversing/str_audit.py inspect() and refpack(); independent bounded section/record walker, source-inspected operations/simpsons_str.bms is extraction reference.
methods.hash: For observed ASCII names: h0=0; h=(65599*h+byte) & 0xffffffff for each lowercase byte.
methods.bbn: BE u32 at 0x18 alias count,0x1c rig count,0x20 rig table absolute offset,0x24 alias table absolute offset. Rig entry 8B {name absolute offset,hash}; alias entry16B {name absolute offset,hash,zero-based rig index,flags}.
methods.mesh: Read little-endian chunk ID/size/version at0xc8 in the two named bunny meshes; node table at0xe8,100records,12B each. All29BBN rig hashes occur as node IDs in both meshes.
methods.acs: Walk size-prefixed records from4 using header byte1 count; +8 BE ID joins BBN alias hash, alias rig index selects BBN rig hash; find matching LE mesh node ID. Matrix semantics excluded from this provenance investigation.

normalizer_snapshot.note: New 2026-10-22 observation; differs from 55,998-row 2026-10-19 docs snapshot. Do not silently overwrite historical provenance.

plugin_chunk.interpretation: RenderWare HAnim hierarchy interpretation; node IDs and indices observed directly. No pose reconstruction or runtime execution.

bunny_attachment_chain.confidence: Observed exact numeric/hash joins, through BBN alias and rig tables to both model node tables. Rig index and model node index are distinct namespaces. Pose matrices, bone-local/world spaces, skin weights, dimensions and original runtime binding behavior remain unvalidated.

limitations: The 401-path pasted inventory is a subset; five other files occur in canonical collision directories.
401 Full/FullFlattened pairs were byte-verified, but only the recorded three original STR archives and their listed members received archive-level confirmation here.
ACS record+8 IDs in other assets can remain unresolved or may address a rig node directly; do not assume every ACS ID joins these four BBN alias tables.
HAnim/plugin field interpretation supports numeric ID association, not an animated skeleton importer.
Only bunny_dark LOD3/LOD5 meshes were checked for the complete BBN-to-mesh hash chain.
The source root contains proprietary game bytes; this ledger stores paths, hashes and numeric observations rather than raw assets.
